1. Why is political inquiry important in social science research ? Discuss the role of interpretation in political analysis.
2. Describe the epistemological debates in quantitative approach.
3. Discuss the significance of a literature review in conducting research.
4. What are the essential elements of an effective research design? Explain with the help of a research design model.
5. Elucidate the process of formulating a research problem. Discuss the way it contributes to the quality of research.
6. Explain the empirical method of political science research
7. What is discourse analysis ? Describe techniques available to the discourse analyst to understand leadership's ideology while doing qualitative research.
8. Critically evaluate the role of archival research in political inquiry.
9. Discuss the elements of ethnographic research. Explain the ways ethnography has contributed in enriching political science research.
10. Write short notes. on any two of the following :
(a) Qualitative analysis
(b) Objectivity in political inquiry
(c) Sources and citations
(d) Research question
